players-only: <red>Only players can use this; it needs a position or a menu.
help:
<gold><bold>Estate</bold> <gray>- land claims. <white>/land</white> opens the menu.
<yellow>/land autoclaim on|off</yellow> <gray>protect what you build automatically
<yellow>/land claim</yellow> <gray>claim the land around you (preview first)
<yellow>/land resize</yellow> <gray>make the claim you're in bigger or smaller
<yellow>/land unclaim</yellow> <gray>remove the claim you're in (cells come back)
<yellow>/land trust <player> [access|containers|build|manage]</yellow> <gray>let a friend in
<yellow>/land untrust <player></yellow>, <yellow>/land trustlist</yellow>
<yellow>/land info</yellow>, <yellow>/land list</yellow>, <yellow>/land borders</yellow>, <yellow>/land rename <name></yellow>
<yellow>/land flag <flag> on|off|default</yellow>, <yellow>/land donate <cells></yellow>, <yellow>/land withdraw <cells></yellow>
help-admin:
<gold>Admin:</gold> <yellow>/land admin</yellow> <gray>reload | settings | menu | set <setting> <value> | get <setting> | bypass [on|off]
<gray>budget <player> [grant|add <cells>] | claims [player] | info|delete|exempt <id> | transfer <id> <player>
<gray>town create <name> <radius> | town create <name> <x1> <z1> <x2> <z2> | town remove <name> | town list
<gray>lookup | lookup at <x> <y> <z> | lookup player <name> | log [count] | expire
denied-claim: <red>This is <owner>'s claim. Ask them to /land trust you.
denied-buffer: <red>This is in someone's buffer: the space around <owner>'s claim stays free. Ask them to trust you, or build a bit further away.
denied-height-cap: <red>Too high: next to <owner>'s claim you can build up to y <height>.
world-not-claimable: <red>Claims can't be made in this world.
claim-empty: <red>A claim needs at least one cell.
bad-height: <red>The bottom of the claim has to be below its top.
too-many-claims: <red>You already have <max> claims, the most allowed. Remove or grow one instead.
in-buffer: <red>That's in someone's buffer (the free space around <owner>'s claim).
no-budget: <red>Not enough claim blocks: that needs <cost> more cells, you have <left> left. Free some with /land or resize.
others-blocks: <red><builder> built something there. You can't claim over another player's build.
auto-created: <green>Your build is now protected! <gray>A claim of <white><cells></white> cells was made around it (<white><left></white> cells left). It grows as you keep building. <yellow>/land</yellow> to manage it.
auto-world-not-claimable: <gray>Builds in this world can't be claimed.
auto-bad-height: <gray>Couldn't work out a height for this claim.
auto-too-many-claims: <yellow>This build isn't protected: you already have <max> claims. Build next to one of them, or remove one with /land.
auto-overlap: <yellow>This part of your build isn't protected: it's inside <owner>'s claim.
auto-in-buffer: <yellow>This part of your build isn't protected: it's in the free space around <owner>'s claim.
auto-no-budget: <yellow>You've used all your claim blocks. Free some with /land or resize.
auto-others-blocks: <yellow>This part of your build isn't protected: <builder> built there first.
build-tip: <gold>Nice build!</gold> <gray>It isn't protected yet: anyone could break it. Claim it to keep it safe (<white><blocks></white> blocks so far).
build-tip-turn-on: <green>[Turn on auto-claim]</green> <gray>protects what you build from now on
build-tip-menu: <aqua>[Open /land]</aqua> <gray>claim it yourself and see your options
autoclaim-on: <green>Auto-claim is on.</green> <gray>Once you've placed <white><threshold></white> blocks in one spot, a claim is made around them and grows as you build.
autoclaim-off: <yellow>Auto-claim is off.</yellow> <gray>Use /land claim to protect builds yourself.
menu-info-lore:
<gray>Claim blocks: <white><used></white> of <white><limit></white> cells (<green><left> left</green>)
<gray>Claims: <white><claims></white> of <white><max></white>
<gray>Auto-claim: <white><autoclaim></white>
<gray>You're in: <white><here>
menu-borders-lore:
<gray>Shows claim borders around you for a few seconds.
<green>Green</green><gray>: yours  <red>Red</red><gray>: others  <yellow>Yellow</yellow><gray>: buffer
menu-new-lore:
<gray>Claim <white><size>x<size></white> cells around you (<white><cost></white> cells).
<gray>You see a preview before anything happens.
menu-resize-lore:
<gray>Make the claim you're standing in
<gray>bigger or smaller, side by side.
menu-trust-lore:
<gray>Let friends use doors, chests or build
<gray>in the claim you're standing in.
menu-autoclaim-lore:
<gray>When on, placing <white><threshold></white> blocks in one spot
<gray>claims them, and the claim grows as you build.
<yellow>Click to switch
menu-flags-lore: <gray>See what the claim you're in is protected from.
menu-unclaim-lore:
<gray>Remove the claim you're standing in.
<gray>Its cells come back to you right away.
menu-list-lore: <gray>You have <white><claims></white> claim(s). Click one to see its borders.
no-claims: <yellow>You don't have any claims yet. <gray>Use /land claim, or turn on /land autoclaim.
not-yours: <red>This is <owner>'s claim, and you can't change it.
stand-in-claim: <yellow>Stand in the claim you want to change first.
editor-info-lore:
<gray>Size: <white><cells></white> cells (<white><area></white> blocks of floor)
<gray>Height: y <white><miny></white> to <white><maxy></white>
<gray>Cost: <white><cost></white> cells, <white><left></white> left after
<gray><status>
editor-side-info:
<gray>Pick a side above, then use <red>-</red><gray> and <green>+</green><gray>.
<gray>The white outline shows the new shape (red if it can't be confirmed).
editor-shrink-lore:
<gray>One row of cells less on this side
<gray>(up/down: <white><step></white> blocks)
editor-grow-lore:
<gray>One row of cells more on this side
<gray>(up/down: <white><step></white> blocks)
editor-cant-shrink: <yellow>It can't get any smaller on that side.
editor-cant-grow: <yellow>It can't get any bigger on that side.
editor-preview-lore:
<gray>Closes the menu so you can see the outline.
<gray>Open /land resize or /land claim again to continue.
editor-preview-hint: <gray>The outline stays for a few seconds. Use /land claim or /land resize to keep editing.
trust-add-entry-lore:
<gray>Click to trust them to build.
<gray>You can change the level afterwards.
trust-help-lore:
<white>Access</white><gray>: doors, buttons, beds
<white>Containers</white><gray>: also chests, barrels, furnaces
<white>Build</white><gray>: also place and break, build next to the claim
<white>Manage</white><gray>: also change trust and resize
trust-owner-only: <red>Only the owner can hand out or take away Manage.
unknown-tier: <red>Unknown level '<tier>'. Use access, containers, build or manage.
flag-blockBreakPlace-about: Only you and players you trust can build.
flag-containerAccess-about: Only trusted players can open them.
flag-explosions-about: TNT, creepers, crystals and beds can't break blocks.
flag-fireSpread-about: Fire doesn't spread in or burn blocks away.
flag-fluidFlowIn-about: Liquids from outside stop at the border.
flag-pistonCross-about: Pistons can't push blocks across the border.
flag-mobGriefing-about: Endermen, zombies, ravagers and withers leave blocks alone.
flag-entityDamage-about:
Only trusted players can hurt pets, animals,
item frames and armour stands.
flag-pvp-about: Whether players can fight each other here.
list-entry-lore:
<gray>#<id> in <white><world>
<gray>Middle: <white><x>, <z>
<gray>Size: <white><cells></white> cells, y <white><miny></white> to <white><maxy>
<gray>Trusted players: <white><trusted>
<gray>Never expires: <white><exempt>
<yellow>Click to show its borders
list-empty-lore: <gray>Use New claim, or turn on auto-claim.
unclaim-yes-lore:
<gray>You get <white><cells></white> cells back.
<gray>Your blocks stay, but aren't protected any more.
unclaimed: <yellow>Removed <white><claim></white>. You have <white><left></white> cells to claim with.
info-buffer: <yellow>Unclaimed, but in the free space around <owner>'s claim.
info-town: <aqua>Unclaimed, in a town zone (no buffers here).
expiry-days: in <days> days if the owner stays away
donate-trusted-only: <red>Only players the owner trusts to build can put cells into this claim.
donate-not-allowed: <red>You can't donate to your own claim.
donate-claim-empty: <yellow>The owner doesn't pay for any cells of this claim, so there's nothing to cover.
withdraw-not-allowed: <red>You haven't put any cells into this claim.
withdraw-no-budget: <red><owner> can't pay for those cells. They need to shrink the claim first.
donated: <green>You put <white><cells></white> cells into <white><claim></white> (<share> in total). <white><left></white> left.
cell-size-locked: cellSize can't change while claims exist (they use <size>-block cells).
config-save-failed: The change works now, but saving config/estate.json failed. See the server log.
reload-failed: <red>Could not reload: <error>. The old settings stay in use.
bypass-on: <light_purple>Bypass on: you can build and open everything everywhere.
budget-info: <gold><player></gold><gray>: <white><used></white> of <white><limit></white> cells used, <white><bonus></white> granted extra (cap <cap>), <white><claims></white> claims.
budget-changed-you: <green>An admin changed your claim budget. You can now claim up to <white><limit></white> cells.
exempt-off: <yellow><claim> (#<id>) expires again when its owner stays away.
town-created: <green>Town zone <white><town></white> made: <x1>, <z1> to <x2>, <z2>. No buffers apply there.
lookup-natural: <gray><x>, <y>, <z>: <white><block></white>, not placed by a player (or the record is older than the retention time).
lookup-player: <gold><player></gold><gray> has <white><count></white> placed blocks on record. Newest:
log-failed: <red>Could not read the log. See the server log.
expire-ran: <gray>Removed <white><count></white> claim(s) of players away for over <days> days.
